card.title: Notification channel
card.hint: If the selected channel is unavailable, the system falls back in the order Telegram → Email.
card.setUpInAccount: Channels are set up in the Account section, together with the email address and Telegram.

preview.title: Notification preview
preview.subtitle: The text this recipient would receive. Nothing is sent, queued or logged by opening this.
preview.noSideEffects: Preview only: no notification is created and no rule is switched on.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.channelNotReadyHint: This recipient has neither a linked Telegram account nor a verified email, so this notification would end as undeliverable.
preview.nothingHint: This status has no notification to render: the event, the registration or the assignment rules it out.

matrix.title: Event and channel
matrix.hint: Which channel each reminder of this event would go to. One notification uses one channel: the override if set, otherwise the recipient preference, otherwise Telegram then Email.
matrix.inAppTitle: In the app is a mirror, not a channel
matrix.inAppHint: Everything sent is also shown in the app. It is never chosen instead of Telegram or Email, it does not take part in the channel choice and it cannot make a notification undeliverable.
matrix.emptyHint: Add a rule to see which channel it would use.
